_purpose: Authored structure for a synthetic specimen. Exact by construction: the same tree rendered the PDF. Score with `python -m pipeline.synthetic_score`.
_caveat: Synthetic. Clean typography and a perfect text layer, so it tests parsing logic, not robustness to real-world PDFs. Prose is lifted from the real corpus; structure is invented.
